days.title: Southern Estates and Gateway
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Heuven
stops.detail: In the southern, mostly hilly part of the park lie several estates such as Heuven and Beekhuizen.

stops.name: Beekhuizen
stops.detail: In the hollow of the Beekhuizen stream, some special, characteristic plants such as the opposite-leaved golden-saxifrage also occur.

stops.name: Besucherzentrum Veluwezoom
stops.detail: At the southern edge of the park, near the village of Rheden, is the Veluwezoom Visitor Centre, from which various routes lead into the park.

days.title: Central Peaks and Vantage Points
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Posbank
stops.detail: The approximately 90-meter-high Posbank viewpoint is located in the center of the park.

stops.name: Zijpenberg
stops.detail: These hills, such as the Zijpenberg and the Posbank, are typical of the area today.

days.title: Northern Wilderness and Sands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Signaal Imbosch
stops.detail: The highest point is the approximately 110-meter-high Signaal Imbosch, which lies in a forest north of the Zijpenberg.

stops.name: Elsberg
stops.detail: Two wildlife observation huts were built in the national park: one on the edge of the former agricultural enclave of Herikhuizen, from where the ruins of a former farm can be seen; the other on the Elsberg, from which there is a wide view over the Rheder- and Worthrederheide and the surrounding forests.

stops.name: Rozendaalse Zand
stops.detail: Of these, only the small Rozendaalse Zand remains in the Veluwezoom.
